size_comparison.limitation: Text size is not provider token usage; routed reads, tool output, reasoning, cache and subsequent turns may offset entry reduction.

invocation.candidate_is: Replacement SKILL.md bytes inside an otherwise identical complete installed vet-flat directory, not a standalone markdown prompt invoked from evals/.
invocation.public_tree: Preserve baseline references/, scripts/, viewer and required shared script modules at the same relative paths. Keep both arms equally able to use actual host tools and the local fixture catalog.
invocation.project_state: Use a distinct owned working directory and private .pea-state per session; do not import the repository author profile or runtime state. Only public/synthetic fixture state explicitly assigned to this case may be present.
invocation.native_execution: Use the real native agent tool interface and account authorization already configured by the user. Do not describe tools as unavailable to force chat-only behavior. Shell scripts are actual executions, not narrated simulation.
invocation.fixed_execution: Same selected model/effort/depth, budget enforcement, public source catalog, host capabilities, initial instructions, user-turn schedule and artifact contract in each paired instruction comparison.
invocation.observability: Record native context/read/tool events and exact initial prompt, entry, reference and fixture hashes. If native host internals do not expose exact context bytes, mark that field unavailable instead of claiming a complete assembled-prompt hash.
invocation.script_resolution: Invoke scripts from their installed skill root, or use absolute script paths; working-project --project targets must remain the owned session directory.

shared_budget_ceiling.note: Ceiling for the authorized study, not an additional allowance for this candidate. Include failed/unknown-spend attempts and any separately allocated actor/judge calls; root controller owns reservations and stops.

not_identifiable: Independent effect of deduplication versus removed procedural detail: both are bundled in entry treatment

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: Baseline entry requires a fixed six-month crime window; budget-modes lite specifies three months, and report comparison prose says six months.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: Changing actual evidence windows can confound quality/depth comparisons. Do not extrapolate a shorter observed window.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: Freeze the per-depth fixture and report expected window in the shared case contract; record what the agent actually checked. Do not silently patch only one arm or score a three-month observed count as six.

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: budget-modes still suggests automatic split roles/stronger judges; pipeline.md measured-results introduction instead defaults to a single agent unless explicitly requested.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: Untracked extra models violate the selected model factor and call cap.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: Enforce selected model/effort and no unreserved additional model dispatches in the shared native host. Candidate resolves this ambiguity explicitly; attribute that to the bundled entry change.

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: Budget modes describe lite partly as chat/no-shell, although current native study intentionally provides actual tools in every depth.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: Depth could accidentally become a host-capability factor or suppress useful available work.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: Declare real tool capabilities identically in every arm. Depth means research scope/limits; log capability misuse as behavior rather than pretending tools are absent.

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: Some fixed-question explanatory prose uses broader legal wording than the scoped axis-07 rules, including deposit/advance scope.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: A correct found quote is not legal applicability or factual truth; offline fixture outcomes must not reward an overbroad rule.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: Use scoped expected facts with agreement/rent/payment-stage context; preserve exact frozen sources and record disagreements. No fresh legal claim is established by this offline audit.

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: A concise chat answer or valid JSON alone does not fulfill the complete report contract; deferred/unperformed checks still require unknown states.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: An attractive short answer may lose hard requirements, fixed answers or arithmetic provenance.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: When the case requests a report, verify schema/strict renderer plus case requirement coverage, conditions, quote provenance and arithmetic. Do not require a full report for a small unrelated interruption.

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: Repo AGENTS/CLAUDE and author .pea-state/profile can leak extra instructions or private preferences into native invocations.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: The apparent short entry could still load a large root packet, or answerers could see author/private case data.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: Use independently owned fixture directories with explicit instruction discovery. Keep private gold/rubric out; record discovered host instructions rather than claiming a sterile context without evidence.

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: Offline local fixtures support actual file/tool execution but do not establish live portal availability or current market/legal truth.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: Calling the experiment native does not make synthetic evidence live research.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: Label fixture source classes and retrieval provenance honestly; measure actual artifact/tool actions, with live-source generalization left untested.

offline_assumptions_audit.finding: Reading session-harness prose is not itself enforcement of state integrity, source freeze, idempotency, cancellation or usage accounting.
offline_assumptions_audit.impact: A prompt-only guard can be ignored and reruns may incur unknown spend.
offline_assumptions_audit.required_handling: Keep deterministic controller boundaries constant; freeze sources and invocation hashes; stop unresolved usage/rate limits without automatic retries. Persist output and current state before accepting completion.
